marketCalendar: TSE cash closed Sep21-Sep23; OSE derivatives holiday trading open

items.title: BOJ raises policy rate to 1.25%, highest in 31 years
items.summary: Sep18 decision passed 7-2. Yen weakened despite the hike, making expectation-gap and future guidance more important than the headline hike itself.

items.title: Nasdaq finishes Friday higher; semiconductors remain resilient
items.summary: US 10Y returned near 5% and oil remained above $100, but Nasdaq rose 0.4% Friday and semiconductors supported the index.

items.title: Houthi-claimed attacks around Riyadh revive Gulf risk
items.summary: Saudi/Gulf equities weakened Sunday after missile/drone attacks claimed by Houthis. This can reprice oil, insurance and inflation risk before Japan cash trading resumes Sep24.

items.title: US-China talks cover AI, trade and critical minerals
items.summary: Weekend talks ahead of a Trump-Xi summit included AI safety, trade and steady rare-earth flows. Investable company beneficiaries remain unverified.

items.title: ニッカトー: H1 and FY recurring-profit forecasts raised; dividend increased
items.summary: Kabutan reports H1 recurring profit forecast raised 36.5% to 0.86bn yen, FY raised 12.2% to 1.29bn yen, with H1 dividend raised from 11 to 15 yen.

items.title: 日本インシュレーション / 和田興産 after-close revisions
items.summary: Sep18 after-close revision items are carried forward for Sep24 screening; primary-document verification is required before decision use.

items.title: OSE holiday derivatives trade Sep21-Sep23 while TSE cash is closed
items.summary: Three cash-market holidays create accumulated gap risk. Holiday futures are the primary domestic price-discovery signal until Sep24 cash reopen.

deduplication: Reuters/FISCO retransmissions on Yahoo/SBI are treated as one underlying story where identifiable.
